structureRationale: The level starts with the smallest immediately usable communication for a zero beginner. Structure expands only when uncovered or under-supported targets justify more content; numeric quotas do not drive authoring.

communicativeTargets: ask about a very familiar food preference
express a very simple positive food preference
use ja and recognize nein in a familiar yes/no exchange
exchange a basic thank-you and polite response
linguisticTargets: mögen in the present forms mag and magst
gaps: additional courtesy expressions such as Entschuldigung
additional recycling and review as evidence shows it is needed

notes: The listed lessons are only the content currently built, not a target count for Pre-A1.
